messages.subject: Session initialization or unique identifier
parts:
Howdy,

I'm working on an Shiny App that allows the user to generate files. I want to generate these in separate directories so one user doesn't overwrite another users files. I can do this by setting up directories when the session starts or I can do it with some sort of unique identifier for the specific session. Can someone tell me how I can determine,  in the server.R function, when it's being called for the first time? Or alternatively can someone point to something in the session (third argument in the server function) that will be unique to the current user? I looked in session$user but it looks to be null. I've looked into the documentation of the session variable:

http://shiny.rstudio.com/reference/shiny/latest/session.html

But I haven't been able to find something that has what I'm looking for.

Thanks
John
